title: Up-Front Amount Added After Returned Payments — Kestrel Return Balance Plan
content:
**Risk schedule — returned payments.** On a returned Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, a history of returned payments adds an up-front amount to the return balance payment:

- where a balloon returned payment posted in the 12 calendar months ending on the payment date, USD 75.00 is added to the return balance payment;
- where none posted in those months but one or more posted in the 24 calendar months ending on the payment date, USD 40.00 is added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

A window of N calendar months ending on the payment date takes in the dates on or before the payment date that fall fewer than N whole calendar months before it.

| Latest balloon returned payment | Added to the return balance payment |
|---|---|
| Within the 12 months | USD 75.00 |
| Older than 12 months but within 24 | USD 40.00 |
| None within 24 months | None |
